children: Overview
Business management solutions provider's Q3 revenue rose 5%, a slight beat of analyst expectations
Net income for Q3 fell year-over-year amid soft client hiring trends
Company repurchased $9 mln in stock during Q3
Outlook
Company expects 2026 gross billings growth of 3% to 4%
Company sees 2026 average WSE growth of 1% to 2%
Company expects 2026 gross margin as percent of gross billings at 2.70% to 2.75%
Result Drivers
PEO SERVICES GROWTH - Co said revenue growth was driven by increased worksite employees from net new clients and higher average billings per employee
RATE INCREASES - Co said improved conditions in the workers' compensation market and ability to secure rate increases supported results
LOWER FAVORABLE ADJUSTMENTS - Co said workers' compensation expense included smaller favorable adjustments than a year ago
